DataSource.//: The data is baked into the image and changes only with a deploy, so nothing watches the file.

Caching.//: Cloudflare keeps the rendered pages, so the app's own cache can be smaller (each row ~1 KB: ~5 MB, not ~25 MB). A miss is recomputed from the data already in memory.

Api.//: companypaisa.com is served through Cloudflare, which puts each visitor's own IP in this header.
Api.//EnableSwaggerUi: No /swagger page on the live site (Zee, 2026-11-26). /openapi/v1.json stays for partners. Api__EnableSwaggerUi=true brings the page back.

Analytics.//: Railway variables: Analytics__ConnectionString = ${{Postgres.DATABASE_URL}}, Analytics__DashboardKey = a long random secret. Without a connection string nothing is recorded.

Hosting.//: The one address search engines should index; the railway.app address and www. redirect here.
